chunks: And ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: “A bondwoman of mine committed adultery; may I sell her child?” He said: “Yes.” I said: “May I perform hajj with its price?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.بِثَمَنِهِ: with its price or sale proceeds
key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: a bondwoman or female slave owned by a master

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell the child of a bondwoman born from zina and use the price for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the child born from zina by a bondwoman and the permissibility of selling that child. It also states that the proceeds from that sale may be used for hajj.
